ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio is heavily dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels, estimated at approximately 96% dark to 4% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels primarily attributed to scarring and barnacles.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity dark field across the entire ventral area; high-contrast contiguous pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips (barnacle colonies) and sparse, thin linear streaks (scars) distributed across the left and center-lower lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an acute internal vertex angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth of depression is significant relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge boundary; moderate frequency peaks with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels from the mean edge line, isolated against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep along the mid-portion of the trailing edge towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, high-contrast, textured light-beige pixel clusters concentrated at the terminal tips of both the left and right lobes; additional small, circular high-intensity spots scattered near the center-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions; a parallel series of three rake marks visible on the left lobe and individual vertical scratches near the lower central peduncle connection.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations at the lateral tips providing an irregular, non-smooth boundary; multiple sets of linear rake-mark scars resulting in local loss of dark pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: The barnacle clusters at the distal tips are exceptionally pronounced, extending beyond the structural tissue boundary of the fluke lobes.
